dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あ、こんにちは朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "Oh, hello, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Oh, hello, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp:
屋上の扉を開けると、丁度、萌先輩がコンロに
火を点けているところだった。
dialogues.en:
When I opened the door to the roof top, Moe-sempai was
there, turning the stove on.
dialogues.text:
When I opened the door to the roof top, Moe-sempai was
there, turning the stove on.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あんたも来るなら来るで、もっと早く来なさ
　いよね。テーブル組み立てちゃったじゃない」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, Asakura, if you're coming, you have to get here
earlier. We've finished setting up the table already!"
dialogues.text:
"Hey, Asakura, if you're coming, you have to get here
earlier. We've finished setting up the table already!"

dialogues.jp: こいつは、全部俺に押しつける気でいやがる。
dialogues.en: She's trying to force everything on me.
dialogues.text: She's trying to force everything on me.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「あの、もう少し待ってもらえますか？　これ
　から具を入れますから」
dialogues.en:
"Can you wait for a little bit? I'm going to put some
ingredients in now."
dialogues.text:
"Can you wait for a little bit? I'm going to put some
ingredients in now."

dialogues.jp:
そう言って、萌先輩がクーラーボックスの留め
金を外す。
dialogues.en: Moe spoke and unlocked the cooler box.
dialogues.text: Moe spoke and unlocked the cooler box.

dialogues.jp: 「なんか、材料が違いますね？」
dialogues.en: "The ingredients look different today."
dialogues.text: "The ingredients look different today."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「南蛮鍋をしようかと思ってるんです」
dialogues.en: "We're trying Nanban hot pot today."
dialogues.text: "We're trying Nanban hot pot today."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「南蛮？」
dialogues.en: "Nanban?"
dialogues.text: "Nanban?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい、｛かも／鴨｝を入れるんですよ」
dialogues.en: "Yes. We're going to use duck meat."
dialogues.text: "Yes. We're going to use duck meat."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「鴨？　はぁ、そりゃ凄いな」
dialogues.en: "Duck? That's pretty amazing."
dialogues.text: "Duck? That's pretty amazing."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「鴨って美味しいよね。あたしすっごく好き」
dialogues.en: "Ducks are delicious. I love them."
dialogues.text: "Ducks are delicious. I love them."

dialogues.jp: 眞子が滅多に見せない、｛ほころ／綻｝んだ笑顔を見せる。
dialogues.en: Mako spoke with a big smile, which was rare for her.
dialogues.text: Mako spoke with a big smile, which was rare for her.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだか、よく食べてる言い方だが……」
dialogues.en: "It sounds like you eat duck often......"
dialogues.text: "It sounds like you eat duck often......"

dialogues.jp: 鴨って高いんじゃないか？
dialogues.en: I thought ducks were expensive.
dialogues.text: I thought ducks were expensive.

dialogues.jp: もしかして、こいつ……お嬢？
dialogues.en: Are they...... rich girls?
dialogues.text: Are they...... rich girls?

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、そろそろ始めましょう」
dialogues.en: "Shall we start now?"
dialogues.text: "Shall we start now?"

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩が、張り切ってクーラーボックスの｛ふた／蓋｝を
カパッと開ける。
dialogues.en: Moe opened up the lid of the cooler box.
dialogues.text: Moe opened up the lid of the cooler box.

dialogues.jp: 「空っぽ？」
dialogues.en: "It's empty......"
dialogues.text: "It's empty......"

dialogues.jp: クーラーボックスの中は、もぬけの殻だった。
dialogues.en: There was nothing inside of the cooler box.
dialogues.text: There was nothing inside of the cooler box.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「ごめんなさい……今朝は慌ててたものですか
　ら、材料入れ忘れてしまったみたいです……」
dialogues.en:
"I'm sorry...... I was in a hurry this morning, and I guess
I forgot to pack the ingredients......"
dialogues.text:
"I'm sorry...... I was in a hurry this morning, and I guess
I forgot to pack the ingredients......"

dialogues.jp: ……マジっすか？
dialogues.en: ......Is she serious?
dialogues.text: ......Is she serious?

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「もうっ、お姉ちゃんったら！　なんてことし
　てくれるのよ！」
dialogues.en: "Hey, oneechan! What are you doing?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, oneechan! What are you doing?"

dialogues.jp:
食べ物の恨みは怖いと言うが……それをひとり
で立証するがのごとく、眞子が憤激する。
dialogues.en:
A grudge match over food is scary...... Mako started going
off on Moe-sempai.
dialogues.text:
A grudge match over food is scary...... Mako started going
off on Moe-sempai.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんなさい……ごめんなさい……」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry...... I'm sorry......"
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry...... I'm sorry......"

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩は俺と眞子に対し、交互に頭をペコペコ
と下げ続ける。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai bowed at Mako and me and apologized.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai bowed at Mako and me and apologized.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あたしの……鴨が……」
dialogues.en: "My duck......"
dialogues.text: "My duck......"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「いや、お前の鴨じゃないと思うがな」
dialogues.en: "It's not exactly your duck."
dialogues.text: "It's not exactly your duck."

dialogues.jp:
軽口を叩きつつも、眞子の落ち込みようにちと
同情してしまう。
dialogues.en: However, I did feel her pain.
dialogues.text: However, I did feel her pain.

dialogues.jp:
まるで、砂漠を｛さまよ／彷徨｝う旅人が、自分の目指して
いたオアシスが、幻であったことに気づいた時
のようだ。
dialogues.en:
It was as if a lost traveler in the desert found out that
the oasis he was heading towards was only a mirage.
dialogues.text:
It was as if a lost traveler in the desert found out that
the oasis he was heading towards was only a mirage.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「とにかく、お昼を確保しなくちゃ……朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, we have to get something for lunch...... Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, we have to get something for lunch...... Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「なんだよ」
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.jp:
なんだか、むちゃくちゃかったるくなりそうな、
そんな予感がする。
dialogues.en: I sense something troublesome......
dialogues.text: I sense something troublesome......

dialogues.jp: ペコペコ
dialogues.en: Moe continued to bow.
dialogues.text: Moe continued to bow.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あたしたちのお昼、購買で買ってきて」
dialogues.en: "Could you go buy our lunch from the school store?"
dialogues.text: "Could you go buy our lunch from the school store?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり……」
dialogues.en: "I knew it......"
dialogues.text: "I knew it......"

dialogues.jp: ペコペコ
dialogues.en: She bowed at me again.
dialogues.text: She bowed at me again.

dialogues.jp: 「なぜ俺が？」
dialogues.en: "Why me?"
dialogues.text: "Why me?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「男だから」
dialogues.en: "Because you're the man."
dialogues.text: "Because you're the man."

dialogues.jp: ペコペコ
dialogues.en: Another bow.
dialogues.text: Another bow.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、お前が行け」
dialogues.en: "Then you should go."
dialogues.text: "Then you should go."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあって、何よ、じゃあって！」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean by that?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean by that?"

dialogues.jp: ペコペコ
dialogues.en: She's still bowing.
dialogues.text: She's still bowing.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「ほら！　早くしないと、｛・・・・・／あたしたち｝のお昼が
　なくなっちゃうでしょ！」
dialogues.en: "Move! Hurry up, or our lunch will be gone!"
dialogues.text: "Move! Hurry up, or our lunch will be gone!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ったく、しゃーねぇーなー」
dialogues.en: "Good grief..."
dialogues.text: "Good grief..."

dialogues.jp: ここでは立場的に俺の分が悪い。
dialogues.en: I guess I'm in a weaker position here.
dialogues.text: I guess I'm in a weaker position here.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あたし、アンパンとクリームパンね」
dialogues.en: "I want a bean paste bun and a cream bun."
dialogues.text: "I want a bean paste bun and a cream bun."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「了解」
dialogues.en: "All right."
dialogues.text: "All right."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんなさい……ごめんなさい……」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry...... I'm sorry......"
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry...... I'm sorry......"

dialogues.jp: ペコペコ
dialogues.en: Bow, bow.
dialogues.text: Bow, bow.

dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩は何がいいですか？」
dialogues.en: "What would you like to eat, Moe-sempai?"
dialogues.text: "What would you like to eat, Moe-sempai?"

dialogues.jp:
先ほどから、頭を下げつづけていることには、
気づいていたが、いまいち、ツッコミどころが
なかったのだ。
dialogues.en:
I noticed that she's been bowing for the last few minutes,
but I had nothing to say about it.
dialogues.text:
I noticed that she's been bowing for the last few minutes,
but I had nothing to say about it.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「え、あの……では、どら焼きをお願いします」
dialogues.en: "What? ......Well, then I'll have some bean paste waffles."
dialogues.text: "What? ......Well, then I'll have some bean paste waffles."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「他には？」
dialogues.en: "Anything else?"
dialogues.text: "Anything else?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「いえ、どら焼きだけでいいです。どら焼きを
　３つ、お願いします」
dialogues.en: "No thank you. I'll just have 3 bean paste waffles."
dialogues.text: "No thank you. I'll just have 3 bean paste waffles."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en: "You want 3?"
dialogues.text: "You want 3?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp: あなたはキャット型ロボットですか？
dialogues.en: She sounds like a character from a famous animation...
dialogues.text: She sounds like a character from a famous animation...

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「あ、あと牛乳もお願いします。餡子と牛乳っ
　てとっても合うんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, and can you get some milk too? Bean paste and milk go
well together."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, and can you get some milk too? Bean paste and milk go
well together."

dialogues.jp:
ニッコリ微笑む嬉しそうな笑顔。本当に好きみ
たいだ。
dialogues.en:
She made a big smile as she spoke. I guess she really likes
it.
dialogues.text:
She made a big smile as she spoke. I guess she really likes
it.

dialogues.jp:
オーダーを聞き終えると、ふたりに背を向け、
急いで校舎内に向かう。
dialogues.en:
As soon as I got their orders, I turned back and hurried to
the store.
dialogues.text:
As soon as I got their orders, I turned back and hurried to
the store.

dialogues.jp: 屋上の扉を開け、階段を駆け下りる。
dialogues.en: I opened the door and went down the stairs.
dialogues.text: I opened the door and went down the stairs.

dialogues.jp: そうやって、一応、急いではみたものの……。
dialogues.en: I did my best to hurry......
dialogues.text: I did my best to hurry......

dialogues.jp:
予想通りというか、どら焼きとか鴨だとか騒い
でいるうちに、購買のパンは売り切れていた。
dialogues.en:
However by the time I got there, all the food in the store
was sold out.
dialogues.text:
However by the time I got there, all the food in the store
was sold out.

dialogues.jp: 「まいったな……今日は昼抜きかぁ」
dialogues.en: "Man...... we have to starve without lunch today?"
dialogues.text: "Man...... we have to starve without lunch today?"

dialogues.jp:
俺はいいとしても、また萌先輩はペコペコする
のだろう。そして俺は眞子の鉄拳制裁を食らい、
コンクリートの床にキッス……。
dialogues.en:
I can take it, but it's going to make Moe-sempai feel
guiltier. Mako might knock me out and I'll end up kissing
the floor.
dialogues.text:
I can take it, but it's going to make Moe-sempai feel
guiltier. Mako might knock me out and I'll end up kissing
the floor.

dialogues.jp: うーむ。
「しゃあない」
dialogues.en: "I have no choice."
dialogues.text: "I have no choice."

dialogues.jp:
お腹と背中がくっつきそう……と言うか、背に
腹はかえられないと言うのか。
dialogues.en: I was starving, and I had to do something.
dialogues.text: I was starving, and I had to do something.

dialogues.jp:
俺は購買のおばちゃんに袋をもらうと、人気の
ないところで手を握る。
dialogues.en:
I got an empty bag from the store, and went to a quiet area.
Then I held my hands.
dialogues.text:
I got an empty bag from the store, and went to a quiet area.
Then I held my hands.

dialogues.jp:
目を｛つむ／瞑｝り、イメージを膨らませると、徐々に手
の中に確かな感覚が広がっていく。
dialogues.en:
As I closed my eyes, and imagined, I felt a sensation in my
hands.
dialogues.text:
As I closed my eyes, and imagined, I felt a sensation in my
hands.

dialogues.jp: ――ポンポン
dialogues.en: Something appeared.
dialogues.text: Something appeared.

dialogues.jp:
次第に袋の重さが増し、比例するように俺の空
腹感が増す。
dialogues.en:
Eventually, the bag started to get heavy, and I was getting
hungrier.
dialogues.text:
Eventually, the bag started to get heavy, and I was getting
hungrier.

dialogues.jp:
目を開けると、八橋、大福、、饅頭、どら焼き、
などなどの和菓子が、袋に２０個ぐらい詰まっ
ていた。
dialogues.en:
When I opened my eyes, there were roughly 20 different
Japanese sweets in the bag, like bean paste waffles, bean
paste crepes, bean and rice cakes, and rice cake balls.
dialogues.text:
When I opened my eyes, there were roughly 20 different
Japanese sweets in the bag, like bean paste waffles, bean
paste crepes, bean and rice cakes, and rice cake balls.

dialogues.jp: 「ま、こんなもんだろう」
dialogues.en: "This should do it."
dialogues.text: "This should do it."

dialogues.jp:
空腹のところに、さらに和菓子を作るためのカ
ロリーを消費したもんだから、少し｛めまい／眩暈｝がする。
dialogues.en:
I felt dizzy from burning my calories to make these sweets
when I'm starving.
dialogues.text:
I felt dizzy from burning my calories to make these sweets
when I'm starving.

dialogues.jp:
俺は袋から手を抜くと、ふらつく足をひきずっ
て屋上に戻ることにした。
dialogues.en:
I hung the bag over my shoulder and dragged myself back to
the roof top.
dialogues.text:
I hung the bag over my shoulder and dragged myself back to
the roof top.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「おそいっ――て、なによそれ？」
dialogues.en: "You're late! What are they?"
dialogues.text: "You're late! What are they?"

dialogues.jp:
怒鳴りかけていた眞子が、透明な袋の中を見て
驚く。
dialogues.en:
Mako looked inside of the bag and asked with a surprised
voice.
dialogues.text:
Mako looked inside of the bag and asked with a surprised
voice.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「和菓子……ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Japanese sweets......?"
dialogues.text: "Japanese sweets......?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ええ、パンは売り切れてたんで」
dialogues.en: "Yes. All the buns were sold out."
dialogues.text: "Yes. All the buns were sold out."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「こんなのどっから買ってきた――ようには、
　見えないわね」
dialogues.en: "It doesn't look like you bought these from the store......"
dialogues.text: "It doesn't look like you bought these from the store......"

dialogues.jp:
俺の創り出す和菓子は、包装されていないから、
色んなものが、ごちゃ混ぜに入っている。
dialogues.en: The sweets I make aren't wrapped. They're always mixed up.
dialogues.text: The sweets I make aren't wrapped. They're always mixed up.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「もしかして……毒入り？」
dialogues.en: "Are these poisonous?"
dialogues.text: "Are these poisonous?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「んなわけねーだろうが」
dialogues.en: "No way!"
dialogues.text: "No way!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「まあいいか。背に腹はかえられないし」
dialogues.en: "Oh well, I guess we'll just have these."
dialogues.text: "Oh well, I guess we'll just have these."

dialogues.jp:
袋の中に手を突っ込んで、眞子が、はむっと大
福を口に含む。
dialogues.en:
Mako stuck her hand in the bag, and put a bean rice cake bun
into her mouth.
dialogues.text:
Mako stuck her hand in the bag, and put a bean rice cake bun
into her mouth.

dialogues.jp: ……マジで毒が入ってたらどうするんだ？
dialogues.en: ......What would she do if it was really poisonous?
dialogues.text: ......What would she do if it was really poisonous?

dialogues.jp:
「あ、萌先輩もどうぞ。頼まれてたどら焼きは
　確保できましたんで」
dialogues.en:
"Please have some, Moe-sempai. I did get your bean paste
waffles."
dialogues.text:
"Please have some, Moe-sempai. I did get your bean paste
waffles."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい、ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Okay, thank you very much."
dialogues.text: "Okay, thank you very much."

dialogues.jp:
袋の中にごそごそと手を入れ、萌先輩がどら焼
きを手にする。
dialogues.en:
She put her hand inside of the bag and got the bean paste
waffle out.
dialogues.text:
She put her hand inside of the bag and got the bean paste
waffle out.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「おいしいです」
dialogues.en: "It's very good."
dialogues.text: "It's very good."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「それはよかったです」
dialogues.en: "I'm glad you like it."
dialogues.text: "I'm glad you like it."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「どうもありがとうございました」
dialogues.en: "Thank you so much."
dialogues.text: "Thank you so much."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「え？　なにがです？」
dialogues.en: "For what?"
dialogues.text: "For what?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉くんがいてくれなかったら、お昼を食べ
　られないところでした」
dialogues.en: "If you weren't here, we were going to starve."
dialogues.text: "If you weren't here, we were going to starve."

dialogues.jp: ペコリと頭が下げられる。
dialogues.en: She bowed at me.
dialogues.text: She bowed at me.

dialogues.jp:
「あ、いや、いいですよ、別にそんなの。ミス
　なんて誰にでもあることだし」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, you don't have to feel that way. Everybody makes
mistakes."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, you don't have to feel that way. Everybody makes
mistakes."

dialogues.jp:
本当にありがたがられることなんてないのに、
萌先輩はゆっくりと首を横に振って微笑む。
dialogues.en: She slowly shook her head and smiled softly.
dialogues.text: She slowly shook her head and smiled softly.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ほんとうに、ありがとうございました♪」
dialogues.en: "Thank you very much."
dialogues.text: "Thank you very much."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あ……はい」
dialogues.en: "Oh...... you're welcome."
dialogues.text: "Oh...... you're welcome."

dialogues.jp:
買い出しは面倒だし、腹は減ったが、萌先輩の
こんな笑顔がご褒美なら、それもいいかな。
dialogues.en:
I went through some drama and I'm starving, but I guess
everything's all right now that I got to see her pretty
smile.
dialogues.text:
I went through some drama and I'm starving, but I guess
everything's all right now that I got to see her pretty
smile.

dialogues.jp:
なんて、ついつい、青い空を見上げながら思っ
てしまった。
dialogues.en: I thought that while I looked up at the blue sky.
dialogues.text: I thought that while I looked up at the blue sky.

dialogues.jp: ◆お昼は和菓子◆
dialogues.en: ◆Japanese sweets for lunch◆
dialogues.text: ◆Japanese sweets for lunch◆

dialogues.jp:
鴨の入った南蛮鍋の予定だった今日のお昼は、
萌先輩が材料を忘れ中止に。
dialogues.en:
We were going to have Nanban hot pot with duck in, but it
was canceled because Moe-sempai forgot to bring the
ingredients.
dialogues.text:
We were going to have Nanban hot pot with duck in, but it
was canceled because Moe-sempai forgot to bring the
ingredients.

dialogues.jp:
激怒する眞子に言われ購買に走るが、予想通り
パンは売り切れ。仕方なく和菓子を出してふた
りに持っていく。
dialogues.en:
I ran to the store as Mako barked at me, but all the buns
were sold out as I expected. Having no other choice, I made
some Japanese sweets, and took them to the two girls.
dialogues.text:
I ran to the store as Mako barked at me, but all the buns
were sold out as I expected. Having no other choice, I made
some Japanese sweets, and took them to the two girls.

dialogues.jp:
買出しは面倒だし、腹は減ったが、萌先輩の嬉
しそうな笑顔がご褒美なら、それもいいかな。
dialogues.en:
I went through some drama and I'm starving, but I guess
everything's all right now that I got to see Moe-sempai's
pretty smile.
